company.name: Knowtex
company.shortDescription: Knowtex helps create visit notes from medical conversations.
company.description: Knowtex provides savings in administrative work, streamlines organisational efficiency, ensures visits are billed at the appropriate level of service, and has personable conversations with patients. It helps create visit notes from medical conversations. For inquiries, an online inquiry form is available on their website.

productsAndServices.description: A healthcare AI platform that converts clinical conversations and fragmented healthcare data into structured documentation, automated workflows, coding outputs, and clinical insights.
productsAndServices.name: Knowtex Clinical AI Platform

productsAndServices.description: An ambient voice AI service that turns clinician-patient conversations into structured medical notes, reducing manual documentation and supporting direct review and EHR upload.
productsAndServices.name: Ambient Clinical AI Documentation

productsAndServices.description: An AI-assisted coding service that recommends diagnosis, CPT, and evaluation and management codes from clinical documentation to support accurate billing and code capture.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Clinical Coding

productsAndServices.description: An AI automation service for executing repetitive documentation, coding, ordering, and care-coordination workflows across clinical departments.
productsAndServices.name: Clinical Workflow Automation

productsAndServices.description: A clinical information and analytics service that summarizes patient records and operational activity into structured views for care delivery, review, and performance improvement.
productsAndServices.name: Clinical Intelligence and EHR Insights
